name: The Skeptic
ceo_note: Strip the jargon and more than half the pool is sponsor APIs chained to a prompt, and several ideas (AgentFICO, Stump Market, Kernel Swarm, Flytrap, Coyote Time, Save States) already exist as products or as a sponsor's own feature. Only Netting House, Memory Blame and Vault Heist have an engine of their own as written; Fire Drill becomes the strongest once its fix is a deterministic policy engine with a measured breach-versus-utility table, not Claude patching a prompt it wrote. Whatever you build, make the thing that decides the outcome (moves money, blocks a call, settles a coin) code you wrote and can verify, with Claude doing the reasoning around it.
changed: I added the render-parity shield (B-P2, the same core as my A-P2) at #6 because the Impact Analyst converged on it independently; no other pivot beat my picks on substance, and the Callback, checkout-heatmap and Proof-of-Bug variants add buyers, not engines.

name: The Impact Analyst
ceo_note: Only two problems in this pool are documented, costly and frequent today: small-business late payment (Netting House) and payment-redirect fraud (Fire Drill). Most 'agent economy' ideas solve problems that exist mainly inside the idea (agent credit scores, agent AML, agent-only price cloaking), and every glasses, kernel and pure-game idea is a toy through my lens. If you build Fire Drill, ship the callback defense for human AP desks too, because that is where roughly $3B a year is lost right now, and agents with bank-change authority are still rare.
changed: Same five bets: I swapped my B-P8 and B-P2 for the near-identical C-P1 and A-P2, so the council's votes land together on the versions other agents also proposed.

name: The Venture Scout
ceo_note: Nothing in this pool is a new category: every good idea has funded neighbors, so you win by owning a narrow angle and naming the competitor before the judge does. Bet on Fire Drill with a real callback: the judge-on-the-phone moment is the best wow here, and the callback turns a monthly drill into daily infrastructure, but drop 'KnowBe4 for AI agents', because KnowBe4 now ships agent security for Claude. Fix Vault Heist's prior-art line before anyone repeats it: Tensor Trust from Berkeley is multiplayer, and Gray Swan launched a $300K agent-hacking arena with Anthropic two days ago.
changed: No change in the picks: B-P8 converged on C-P1, and A-P1's provenance policy makes a better trigger for its callback, which strengthens the top pick rather than replacing it.
